{{Conjecture|legends}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], a '''Rodian''' criminal and a partner attempted to kidnap from the [[Stone Grotto]] dinner club on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] a [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|courier]] representing a rival crime syndicate. The [[Courier/Legends|courier]] was in possession of a briefcase containing certain contents that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]' syndicate coveted. The Rodian was armed with a [[Stun gun/Legends|stun gun]] and a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and threatened to blow the entire establishment to bits when a group of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s intervened.

The Rodian kidnappers were ultimately apprehended by local [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] and were pinned with the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Unidentified Rodian partner|another Rodian]] involved in the intrigue.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The adventure offers the possibility that the players can disarm the Rodian with the thermal detonator if they act quickly, otherwise they will face a messy hostage situation.
